description: Table Reachable from Outside a VPC Endpoint
rationale: DynamoDB has no network-level access control of its own: its endpoint is public and any principal holding valid credentials can call it from anywhere on the Internet, so a leaked access key is immediately usable from outside the account's network. Combining a gateway VPC endpoint with a resource-based policy conditioned on aws:SourceVpce is the only way to require that requests arrive through the VPC, which turns stolen credentials alone into an insufficient means of reaching the data.
remediation: Create a gateway VPC endpoint for DynamoDB in the VPCs that use the table, then add a statement to the table policy denying every request whose aws:SourceVpce is not one of them
